comments.body: Done 2026-11-05 (in 0.22.0): a harness whose manifest has an idle rule (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode) stays unknown after the startup grace until a state rule first recognizes its screen, so pane wait --until idle waits through a slow launch. Manifests without an idle rule keep the idle fallback.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

comments.body: 2026-11-06, Foreman slot 5: Codex review helper ibex (p2hn44rthz), started with muster pane new --helper --run codex, remained blank apart from .zshrc loading lines for about four minutes. Process inspection confirmed a live codex process, while muster window showed idle, adapter null, no session. Its review post was held as its prompt is not on its screen. This repeats the starting-versus-idle issue. After sending Ctrl+C, pane read immediately returned no pane on this daemon; the pane disappeared, so a pinned 0.166.0 replacement was started.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

comments.body: 2026-11-06 11:56-11:59, Foreman stage-8 review: helper eagle (p2hnfvhxrz), started with codex --model gpt-6.1-sol -c model_reasoning_effort=medium, drew only shell startup lines for about three minutes while ps showed the Codex process alive. muster window reported idle with adapter/session null. The review wake stayed unread with prompt not on screen. I interrupted that startup and used bunx @openai/codex@0.166.0 in a replacement helper; it drew a real prompt. This repeats the blank-startup state mismatch after this card was marked done.

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
From tooling feedback, 2026-11-01. A helper started with `muster pane new --helper --run 'codex --model … -c model_reasoning_effort=xhigh'` ran Codex 0.166.0, installed 30 minutes earlier. Codex sat at 0% CPU and drew nothing for about 9 minutes, probably a first-launch check on a machine that was swapping. All that time `muster window` showed the pane `idle` with harness `codex`, `pane wait --until idle,blocked` answered `idle` at once, and `pane read` returned only the shell's startup lines. `msg post` held its ring ("its prompt is not on its screen"), so nothing was typed into the shell. The pane read `blocked` only once Codex drew its folder-trust dialog.

The detector publishes a new agent as `unknown` for `STARTUP_GRACE`, 3 s (`crates/muster-detect/src/detector.rs:35`), and then reads the screen. Nothing on a screen Codex has not drawn matches a working or blocked rule, so the pane settles idle. a_2hIfuCglw added the grace for a Codex whose first prompt had not started yet, and it covers only a start quicker than 3 s.

Wanted: a pane whose harness has not drawn a screen of its own reads `unknown`, or a starting state, however long that takes, and `pane wait --until idle` keeps waiting through it. Open: what counts as the harness having drawn its screen (its adapter's first report, or a manifest rule matching), and what a harness with no adapter falls back to.
title: A Codex pane still launching reads idle once a 3-second startup grace ends
